baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَأْسًا (ك ء س) modified by دِهَاقًا (د ه ق).
baseline_models.mechanism: The cup names a vessel together with its drink, while the adjective fills that bounded unit to its upper limit; the phrase therefore pictures maximal abundance held in a container.

activation_trace.role: The cup together with its drink supplies the bounded container-and-content unit.
Filling a cup to its top makes brim-reaching plenitude the adjective's primary contribution.

changed_reading.before: A cup is present with an unspecified intensive quality.
changed_reading.after: The vessel and its drink form one bounded unit filled all the way to its rim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pressure-and-interpenetration branch of د ه ق remains attached to دِهَاقًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of measuring only vertical volume, the modifier can make the contents feel tightly pressed and mutually interpenetrating, turning fullness into material density.

activation_trace.role: The cup supplies the container in which a pressure image can be localized.
Severe pressure and interpenetration recast fullness as compacted density.

changed_reading.before: The adjective reports how much liquid the cup contains.
changed_reading.after: The adjective can also render the cup's contents as densely pressed together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The forceful-emptying branch of د ه ق remains attached to دِهَاقًا and to the cup it modifies.
baseline_models.mechanism: The emptying branch puts the brim-full cup in productive tension: fullness can be a phase in vigorous pouring or circulation rather than a motionless stock.

activation_trace.role: The vessel-and-drink unit gives forceful discharge a concrete source.
Forceful emptying animates the cup as a moment in a flow.

changed_reading.before: A full cup is a static reserve.
changed_reading.after: The full cup may be pictured in vigorous pouring, with plenitude dynamically circulated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The wealth-grasp branch of د ه ق qualifies the concrete cup in كَأْسًا دِهَاقًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rare branch shifts the adjective from fluid quantity to an apportioned grasp of wealth, allowing the cup itself to function as a hand-sized allotment of bounty.

activation_trace.role: The cup provides a discrete object that can embody an allotment.
A grasp of wealth opens an economic rather than merely volumetric reading of the modifier.

changed_reading.before: The phrase offers a quantity of drink.
changed_reading.after: The cup can also be a graspable portion of wealth or bounty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement from mutual questioning and divergent paths to promised disclosure is later recast as direct experience; because a cup is a drink-bearing object, it can serve as an embodied answer to what had remained disputed speech.

activation_trace.role: The drink-bearing cup supplies the sensory object through which the news can become experienced.
Mutual questioning establishes the initial verbal uncertainty.
Taking different paths supplies the mechanism of unresolved disagreement.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised conversion from dispute to recognition.
Tasting as experiential trial turns ingestion into a mode of knowing rather than mere consumption.

structural_cues: 78:1-5 opens with questioning, disagreement, and promised knowing, while 78:24-34 moves into tasting and the presentation of a cup.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the verbal-to-experiential sequence; I infer that the focus cup participates in resolving the disputed report through lived reception. The live alternative is that the cup is only a reward object and carries no epistemic role.

changed_reading.before: The cup is an item of reward.
changed_reading.after: The cup is also a tasted, embodied verification of the report that was previously questioned and disputed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pressure releases downpour, downpour raises vegetation, enclosed gardens hold grapes, and the sequence terminates in a drink-bearing cup. The brim-full cup thus condenses a surah-scale material process into a handheld endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The vessel together with its drink is the terminal container in the proposed supply chain.
Brim fullness marks the completed yield of the chain.
Pressure until liquid is released supplies the chain's extraction mechanism.
Pouring and outpouring move the released liquid into the productive landscape.
Plant growth supplies the transformation from water into produce.
The enclosed garden provides the cultivated container in which the fruit stage is held.
Grapes provide the plausible fruit precursor for the cup's drink.

structural_cues: The provisioning sequence at 78:14-16 and the reward sequence at 78:31-34 both move from an environment to its concentrated yields.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, rain, growth, enclosed gardens, grapes, and the cup; I supply the unspoken transformation of grapes into the cup's drink and the causal links between stages. The live alternative is a non-grape drink and two parallel lists without a material pipeline.

changed_reading.before: The cup is a standalone luxury at the end of a reward list.
changed_reading.after: The cup is the handheld concentration of a cosmic water-and-cultivation process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier outpouring image reactivates the focus root's forceful-emptying branch. Their parallel intensive adjectives allow a dynamic reading in which vigorous pouring and emptying sustain, rather than negate, plenitude.

activation_trace.role: The cup-and-drink unit localizes the earlier outpouring as a serving process.
Forceful emptying makes the cup a dynamic throughput rather than a static store.
The earlier emphatic outpouring supplies the motion that strengthens the focus branch.

structural_cues: 78:14 and 78:34 each pair an indefinite accusative noun with an intensive accusative adjective: مَاءً ثَجَّاجًا and كَأْسًا دِهَاقًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outpouring and forceful emptying; I infer that the formal parallel carries flow into the cup and that replenishment reconciles flow with fullness. The live alternative is the ordinary static brim-full reading.

changed_reading.before: Forceful discharge is a weak, internally tense focus-only possibility.
changed_reading.after: The cup can be continually full through vigorous pouring and circulation, not merely full while motionless.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remote fullness branches in the grain and immediately preceding bodily term echo the focus adjective's brim fullness. The cup becomes the last of several forms brought to completed saturation: irrigated yield, mature form, and filled vessel.

activation_trace.role: Filling to the top provides the focus endpoint of the repeated saturation pattern.
Quenching until fullness supplies an irrigation-scale precursor to the cup's saturation.
Filling a thing until complete places another fullness image immediately before the cup.

structural_cues: The two provisioning blocks at 78:14-16 and 78:31-34 culminate in compact nominal yields, with the second context trigger directly adjacent to the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three branch images of achieved fullness; I infer that their recurrence makes the cup a terminal saturation motif. The live alternative is that the distant branches are independent lexical possibilities with no compositional link.

changed_reading.before: Only the cup is described as full.
changed_reading.after: The cup completes a wider pattern in which provision, maturity, and vessel each reach their proper fullness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cup rim becomes a model of limit and capacity: transgression crosses a limit, fitting recompense equals its counterpart, sufficiency meets need, and truth fits its place like content fits a vessel. Fullness therefore reaches the boundary exactly without becoming overflow.

activation_trace.role: Brim fullness provides the visible relation between quantity and a containing limit.
Crossing the limit supplies the negative counterpart to fullness that stops at the rim.
An amount equal to need supplies exact proportionality rather than indiscriminate excess.
Sufficiency and enrichment make the reward adequate to its recipient.
A right that fits its place like a vessel supplies the explicit capacity-and-fit analogy.

structural_cues: Punitive جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا at 78:26 and rewarding جَزَاءً ... عَطَاءً حِسَابًا at 78:36 bracket the focus cup with two measures of recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transgression, matching measure, sufficiency, vessel-fit, and a brim-full cup; I infer that the rim figures proper capacity and that the reward reaches but does not violate it. The live alternative is that دِهَاقًا denotes sheer abundance without calibration.

changed_reading.after: Brim fullness signifies calibrated plenitude: a gift exactly fitted to capacity and held within its proper limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punitive block withholds cooling drink and substitutes hot, impure liquid; the reward block then presents a cup filled to its rim and names the result recompense. The same ingestion channel is reversed from coerced harm to complete provision.

activation_trace.role: The cup-and-drink unit supplies the positive counterpart to the hostile liquids.
Brim fullness reverses the earlier denial of a desirable drink.
Water drunk with aversion supplies the negative mode of ingestion being reversed.
Hot water makes the punitive drink actively hostile to bodily relief.
Impure dregs make the substitute liquid repellent rather than nourishing.
Recompense identifies the full cup as a responsive outcome, not incidental decor.

structural_cues: 78:24-26 denies relief and supplies hostile liquids; 78:31-36 answers with success, a full cup, and recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed ingestion scenes and recompense language; I infer a deliberate reversal through the focus cup. The live alternative is that the punitive liquids and reward cup are independent list items rather than matched channels.

changed_reading.before: The full cup is a generic luxury.
changed_reading.after: The full cup restores drink as welcome provision by reversing the coerced, hostile drinking of the punitive block.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rare focus image of a grasp of wealth becomes functional when the cup is followed by recompense, sufficient enrichment, and explicit giving. The cup is both drink and a discrete portion of bounty handed to its recipient.

activation_trace.role: The cup supplies a concrete, graspable unit of the reward.
A grasp of wealth shifts the adjective toward an apportioned economic gift.
Recompense makes the cup part of a responsive award.
Sufficiency and enrichment give the allotted portion its adequate scale.
Handing and giving provide the transfer that turns a grasp-image into received bounty.

structural_cues: 78:31-36 is one reward list, and its closing clause names the preceding objects recompense and gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grasp of wealth, recompense, sufficiency, and giving; I infer that the physical cup embodies a hand-delivered allotment. The live alternative is that the wealth branch is inactive and the cup remains only a drink vessel.

changed_reading.before: The recipient receives a full drink.
changed_reading.after: The recipient receives a graspable allotment of bounty whose concrete form is the full cup.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cup is materially full, yet the immediately following soundscape excludes untruth, worthless speech, and mixed verbal noise. Abundance is therefore socially contained: fullness in the vessel does not become disorder in communal hearing.

activation_trace.role: The drink-bearing vessel supplies the material abundance whose social effects are being qualified.
Brim fullness intensifies the abundance without requiring verbal overflow.
The exclusion of untruth removes one form of social corruption from the cup's setting.
Auditory perception makes the post-cup qualification a property of the shared soundscape.
The absence of mixed noisy speech prevents material fullness from spilling into acoustic disorder.

structural_cues: The no-idle-or-false-speech clause at 78:35 follows the full cup at 78:34 without a new reward heading.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a full drink and an immediately adjacent clean soundscape; I infer that the latter qualifies the social mode of enjoying the former. The live alternative is that 78:35 describes the environment generally and says nothing about the cup's effects.

changed_reading.before: The adjective measures only material abundance.
changed_reading.after: The cup figures abundant enjoyment whose communal field remains free of noisy, worthless, or false speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins two peripheral cutting branches, including the packet's split ج ز ي to ج ز ز mapping. It remains anchored to دِهَاقًا and to the cup as a discrete reward unit. Downstream prose should render it only as an exploratory image of an allotted share, never as a claim that the cup is literally broken or that جَزَاء means cutting here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دِهَاقًا through د ه ق B004 modifies the discrete cup named by كَأْسًا.

activation_trace.role: The cup supplies the discrete unit that can be construed as an allotted portion.
Breaking and cutting open a delimited-share image within the focus adjective.
The split-root cutting branch at recompense lets the reward be pictured as a portion cut out for its recipient.

changed_reading.before: The cup is simply full reward.
changed_reading.after: The cup can be pictured as a delimited share cut or apportioned from the larger recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the wine branch of ر و ح from the source occurrence ٱلرُّوحُ. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly permits the cup together with wine or drink, and the adjacent context excludes verbal disorder. Render it as a branch-triggered specification of possible contents, not as a gloss of ٱلرُّوحُ or a definitive identification of the drink.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ك ء س branch includes the vessel together with wine or drink.

activation_trace.role: The cup inventory keeps wine as one possible specification of its contents.
The remote wine image selects the wine possibility latent in the focus cup.
The exclusion of bad or false speech contains the selected wine image within an ordered social setting.

changed_reading.before: The cup contains an unspecified drink.
changed_reading.after: The cup may specifically carry wine, while its setting remains free of vain or corrupt speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping at وَقَالَ and activates both paucity and large-jar branches. It remains anchored to the full focus cup and coheres with regulated speech. Downstream prose should qualify it as lexical counterpoint only, not claim that وَقَالَ denotes either scarcity or a jar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَأْسًا supplies the vessel and دِهَاقًا supplies its fullness.

activation_trace.role: The cup provides the bounded drink container for the counterpoint.
Brim fullness establishes abundance on the material side of the contrast.
Paucity makes permitted and correct speech the scarce counterpart to abundant drink.
The large-jar image unexpectedly enlarges the vessel side while speech itself remains constrained.

changed_reading.before: The cup and the later rule for speech are separate details.
changed_reading.after: The scene can carry an asymmetric economy: the drink container is large and full, while speech is sparse and right.

strongest_changes: The full cup becomes the positive reversal of the earlier hot, impure, and aversive drinking scene.
Rain pressure, outpouring, growth, enclosed gardens, and grapes turn the cup into the concentrated endpoint of a material provision chain.
The rim combines limit, matching recompense, sufficiency, and vessel-fit, changing sheer abundance into calibrated plenitude.
Gift and accounting language activates the rare د ه ق image of a grasp of wealth, so the cup can embody a handed allotment of bounty.
The immediately clean soundscape makes cup-fullness socially ordered rather than verbally overflowing.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context activated both causal chains and remote lexical branches: the same two-word image could function as hydrological endpoint, experiential proof, exact measure, reversed ingestion, social containment, and a graspable reward without collapsing those readings into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The conversion from rain and grapes to the cup's particular drink is reader-supplied rather than stated.
The pressure, forceful-emptying, wealth, and cutting branches of د ه ق remain secondary to the strong brim-full branch.
The social reading depends on taking 78:35 as a qualification of the immediately preceding cup rather than only of the wider environment.
Split-root activations involving ج ز ز and ق ل ل are inspectable lexical experiments and should not be promoted to ordinary glosses.
